title: How to Create Custom Tags: A Guide for Agency Operations
summary: Unlike categories which can be of a broader nature, tags are short and precise. Each event can have multiple tags assigned to it.

#### How to use it


## Make your calendar 4X more powerful using Tackle tag.


#### Phase 1


### Add tags on the Tackle web app


-


Sign in to the Tackle web app with your Google account.


-


From the left panel click on Tags.


-


Then from the top right corner, press "Add new tag" button


-


Select Tag Type> Category> Subcategory> Tag color> Tag visibility> Tag level.


-


After filling out the form, select the Create tag button.


#### Phase 2


### Install the Tackle chrome extension


-


On the left side of the home page, click on “Show more”.


-


You will see the Chrome Extension menu.


-


Click on the Chrome Extension and it will take you to the Chrome Extension Webstore page.


-


Click on the Add to Chrome button. It will be downloaded and run automatically in the background.


#### Phase 3


### Add tags to your Google Calendar events


-


Go to your Google Calendar and you’ll see the chrome extension on the top right side.


-


Login using the same Tackle email.


-


Now select a calendar event and use the tag icon here to add the tags to your events.


## Phase 4


##### Analyze your calendar


Now let’s go back to the Insights page of your Tackle account. Here, you can analyze the data in your calendar by choosing from several chart options. This tool captures the calendar data and categorizes them through the tags. So, you can see the charts of calendar events and activities according to the tags assigned.
